title: Richard Worsfold
author: Luke N.
desc: A program to build basic fundamentals for lifting weights. And to increase speed and strength. This program is to focus on strength and lifting heavy weight to build as much mass as possible also

ex.note: Keep elbow in neutral position. Create a arch in your lower back when laying on your back and drive through your feet. DONT TOUCH DUMBBELLS TOGETHER!!

ss.note: THIS CAN BE DONE BY USING DUMBBELLS OR THE SMITH MACHINE. Recommended to use dumbbells as they help stability but smith machine can go to failure to blow your chest up!!
This can be used by dumbbells or a barbell. Keep your arms slightly bent and raising the weight with your wrists to shoulder height!! Slowly bring the weight down don’t let it fall down!!
Kick the dumbbells up and fully extend arms above your head. THE DUMBBELLS DONT TOUCH AT ALL. Bring the dumbbells down till your arms are 90 degrees and then press back up to starting position!
Hands shoulder width apart. Bring chest to floor and press back up!!
THIS EXERCISE IS SIDE ONE USING ONE ARM. THIS SHOULD BE PUSHED ACROSS YOUR BODY TO SQUEEZE YOUR CHEST. If you can’t do single arm then do both arms for the sets and reps!!!
Drive with your elbow and arms slightly bent. Try not to rely on swinging to get them up. Control the weight on the way down!!

ex.note: Each set is a 3X drop set. You do 12 reps at one weight, then you take it down 1-2 weight plates, then take the weight down again. After that sets done and that arm is done repeat on opposite arm!!
Each set is a 3X drop set. You do 10 reps at one weight, then you take it down 1-2 weight plates, then take the weight down again
First 2 sets are light weight warm up sets. 3rd set is a medium weight warm up to get body used to shifting heavier loads. Last 2 sets are heaviest sets. These should be PB sort of weights!!

This is the usual drop set we do. Start off at a weight that you can do 10 for and it’s like a 7.5/8 out of 10 hard. Then you gonna take 10kg off then do 10 more reps and do that 1 more time then rest

Keep hips in line with chest when leaning forward. Try resist and slowly bringing yourself down until you can’t hold it anymore. THE SLOWER THE MOVEMENT, THE BETTER. This can be done on a Lat pulldown

ss.note: 8 reps on both legs and then your superset of goblet squats is one set. Make sure you drive through your heel on your way up and keep your knee slightly bent at the top of the movement!!

This superset can be done with your heels on a plate and toes on the floor and then squat. Or you can have feet flat on the floor and do the squats. Focus on depth with chest up tall and ass to grass!

ex.note:
TAKE YOUR TIME!
Perform this at a slow pace as we want to focus on height and getting onto the box. When jumping use your arms to help getting onto the box.
This should be done with a wide grip to target your lats more. Fully extend arms at the bottom and puff chest out at the top of movement !!
Place seat of the bench up. This is where your hand rests. This will keep your chest up when performing the row to stop your lower back from folding over. Keep elbow nice and tucked into your body!!

Holding the rope with knuckles facing each other. Take a step back so there’s tension on the cable and pull cable back with your elbows and then bring wrists up to a position similar to flexing biceps
Single arm movements = start with weaker side!! At the top of the movement let your lats stretch out and let the cable pull your arm. Then pull down with your elbows and keep chest puffed up!!
Hands placed shoulder width apart. Fully extend your arms at the top of the movement and stretch out the lats. Pull down with both elbows and slight lean back and push towards you with your palms!!

ss.note: Slight lean forward (ever so slightly) and then pull up with your shoulders and straight arms. Leaning forward helps range of motion when performing the exercise. This will lead to more muscle growth!
Your index fingers and thumbs SHOULD be making contact with upper side of dumbbell when holding it. This will replace grip strength and place more tension on the biceps. Keep elbows tucked in!!

ex.note:
THIS IS THE ELBOW ANCHOR EXERCISE!!!

Drive elbow into the cable machine bar, leaning feet forward as your main anchor. Use as heavy weight as possible. You need to struggle getting the weight up!!!
Keep elbow in neutral position. Create a arch in your lower back when laying on your back and drive through your feet. DONT TOUCH DUMBBELLS TOGETHER!!

Single arm movements = start with weaker side!! At the top of the movement let your lats stretch out and let the cable pull your arm. Then pull down with your elbows and keep chest puffed up!!
Hands placed shoulder width apart. Fully extend your arms at the top of the movement and stretch out the lats. Pull down with both elbows and slight lean back and push towards you with your palms!!

ss.note: Slight lean forward (ever so slightly) and then pull up with your shoulders and straight arms. Leaning forward helps range of motion when performing the exercise. This will lead to more muscle growth!
Your index fingers and thumbs SHOULD be making contact with upper side of dumbbell when holding it. This will replace grip strength and place more tension on the biceps. Keep elbows tucked in!!

ex.note:
THIS IS THE ELBOW ANCHOR EXERCISE!!!

Drive elbow into the cable machine bar, leaning feet forward as your main anchor. Use as heavy weight as possible. You need to struggle getting the weight up!!!
